result.summary: Adds a functional test covering compact blocks received more than two blocks ahead of the active chain tip. It exercises both branches in net_processing: requesting the full block again via getdata when the block was already in flight, and falling back to header processing (fRevertToHeaderProcessing) which marks outbound high-bandwidth peers as protected from eviction.
result.problem: Two code paths in net_processing.cpp for handling far-ahead compact blocks had no test coverage. Either branch could be disabled or removed without causing test suite failures, risking silent regressions in block downloading retries and peer eviction protection.
evidence: Commit message: 'A compact block more than two blocks ahead of the tip is not reconstructed... No test checked what either branch does, so removing both made no test fail.'

PR description: 'Each check fails when only its branch is disabled: fRevertToHeaderProcessing = false fails the protection check, and if (false) in place of if (requested_block_from_this_peer) makes the getdata check time out.'
Fixes linked issue #34618: 'test: cmpctblock: No coverage for fRevertToHeaderProcessing in compact block message handling.'
result.changed_since_previous: No functional changes to the patch; previous description was recorded without a patch ID.
result.card: Adds functional test coverage for compact blocks received more than two blocks ahead of the chain tip. Previously, neither the full-block getdata retry path nor the fallback header-processing path (fRevertToHeaderProcessing) was covered, meaning either branch could be deleted without failing tests. The test verifies both the full-block request and that outbound peers are protected from eviction, resolving issue #34618.

risk.why: Only adds a new functional test script and registers it in the test runner; no node behavior or production code is touched.
